name: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır — Herb Oil Swap)
whyItWorks: Soft-poached eggs over strained Greek yogurt deliver high protein with 0g insoluble fiber; swapping Aleppo chili flakes for sweet paprika avoids capsaicin burn.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm plain strained Greek yogurt (or lactose-free yogurt) with a pinch of garlic powder and salt. Top with two soft-poached eggs and melted butter infused with sweet paprika or dill — strictly hold chili oil and red pepper flakes.
flareEmergencySwap: Use lactose-free Greek yogurt and skip the spiced butter in favor of a plain pat of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Raw minced garlic in the yogurt base
